sn12.63:1.2: cattāro me bhikkhave, āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnaṃ vā anuggahāya.
sn12.63:1.4: kabaḷīkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ.
sn12.63:1.5: ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnaṃ vā anuggahāya.
sn12.63:2.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, dve jayampatikā parittaṃ sambalaṃ ādāya kantāramaggaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ.
sn12.63:2.4: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ jayampatikānaṃ kantāragatānaṃ yā parittā sambalamattā, sā parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.
sn12.63:2.6: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ jayampatikānaṃ evamassa:
sn12.63:2.7: amhākaṃ kho yā parittā sambalamattā, sā parikkhīṇā pariyādinnā
sn12.63:2.9: yannūna mayaṃ imaṃ ekaputtakaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ vadhitvā vallūrañca soṇḍikañca karitvā puttamaṃsāni khādantā dvepimaṃ kantārāvasesaṃ nitthareyyāma, mā sabbeva tayo vinassimhāti.
sn12.63:2.10: atha kho te bhikkhave, dve jayampatikā taṃ ekaputtakaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ vadhitvā vallūrañca soṇḍikañca karitvā puttamaṃsāni khādantā evaṃ naṃ kantārāvasesaṃ nitthareyyuṃ.
sn12.63:2.11: te puttamaṃsāni ceva khādeyyuṃ, ure ca patipiṃseyyuṃ.
sn12.63:3.2: api nu te davāya vā āhāraṃ āhareyyuṃ, madāya vā āhāraṃ āhareyyuṃ, maṇḍanāya vā āhāraṃ āhareyyuṃ, vibhūsanāya vā āhāraṃ āhareyyuṃ.
sn12.63:3.4: nanu te bhikkhave, yāvadeva kantārassa nittharaṇatthāya āhāraṃ āhāreyyunti?
sn12.63:3.6: evameva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave, kabaḷīkāro āhāro daṭṭhabboti vadāmi.
sn12.63:3.7: kabalīkāre bhikkhave, āhāre pariññāte pañcakāmaguṇiko rāgo pariññāto hoti.
sn12.63:3.8: pañcakāmaguṇike rāge pariññāte natthi taṃ saññojanaṃ, yena saññojanena saṃyutto ariyasāvako puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyya.
sn12.63:4.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, gāvī niccammā kuḍḍañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya, ye kuḍḍanissītā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ.
sn12.63:4.3: rukkhañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya, ye rukkhanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ.
sn12.63:4.4: udakañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya, ye udakanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ.
sn12.63:4.5: ākāsañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya, ye ākāsanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ.
sn12.63:4.6: yaññadeva hi sā bhikkhave gāvī niccammā nissāya tiṭṭheyya, ye tannissitā tannissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ.
sn12.63:4.7: evameva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave, phassāhāro daṭṭhabboti vadāmi.
sn12.63:4.8: phasse bhikkhave, āhāre pariññāte tisso vedanā pariññātā honti.
sn12.63:4.9: tīsu vedanāsu pariññātāsu ariyasāvakassa natthi kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti vadāmi.
sn12.63:5.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā puṇṇā aṅgārānaṃ vītaccikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ.
sn12.63:5.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo.
sn12.63:5.4: tamenaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā taṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ.
sn12.63:5.5: atha kho bhikkhave tassa purisassa ārakāvassa cetanā ārakā patthanā ārakā paṇidhi.
sn12.63:5.7: viditaṃ hi bhikkhave, tassa purisassa hoti:
sn12.63:5.8: imañcāhaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ papatissāmi, tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi, maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
sn12.63:5.9: evameva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave manosañcetanāhāro daṭṭhabboti vadāmi.
sn12.63:5.10: manosañcetanāya bhikkhave, āhāre pariññāte tisso taṇhā pariññātā honti.
sn12.63:5.11: tīsu taṇhāsu pariññātāsu ariyasāvakassa natthi kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti vadāmi.
sn12.63:6.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dasseyyuṃ,
sn12.63:6.3: ayaṃ te deva coro āgucārī, imassa yaṃ icchasi taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehīti.
sn12.63:6.5: gacchatha, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ pubbanhasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathāti.
sn12.63:6.7: atha rājā majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
sn12.63:6.11: gacchatha bho, taṃ purisaṃ majjhantikasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathāti.
sn12.63:6.17: gacchatha bho taṃ purisaṃ sāyanhasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathāti.
sn12.63:6.20: api nu so puriso divasaṃ tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayethāti.
sn12.63:6.21: ekissāpi bhikkhave, sattiyā haññamāno tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayetha.
sn12.63:6.22: ko pana vādo tīhi sattisatehi haññamānoti.
sn12.63:6.23: evameva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave, viññāṇāhāro daṭṭhabboti vadāmi.
sn12.63:6.24: viññāṇe bhikkhave, āhāre pariññāte nāmarūpaṃ pariññātaṃ hoti. nāmarūpe pariññāte ariyasāvakassa natthi kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti vadāmīti.
